hooks.name: Warn when local stack is stale
hooks.description: Fetches origin/stack and warns when the local stack ref is behind it. This is intentionally warning-only: it never moves refs or touches the working tree, because a session may start with unrelated uncommitted work.

action.command:
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; git -C "$D" fetch --quiet origin stack >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$D" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/stack || exit 0; git -C "$D" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/stack || exit 0; behind=$(git -C "$D" rev-list --count stack..origin/stack 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; ahead=$(git -C "$D" rev-list --count origin/stack..stack 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then printf '
STALE STACK WARNING: local stack is %s commit(s) behind origin/stack and %s ahead. Sync stack before any merge or push. Suggested safe command: git fetch origin && git switch stack && git merge --ff-only origin/stack

' "$behind" "$ahead" >&2; fi
